# Barcitinib Oral

[Help page (instructions, microbiology, drug properties, etc.)](help-page)
# Patients with eGFR >/= 60 ml/min/1.73 m2:

Baricitinib 4 mg PO qday for 14 days or until discharge (COVID-19) ($$$) R

Baricitinib 4 mg NG qday for 14 days or until discharge (COVID-19) ($$$) R

Baricitinib 4 mg G Tube qday for 14 days or until discharge (COVID-19)

($$$) [R]

# Patients with eGFR 30-59 ml/min/1.73 m2:

Baricitinib 2 mg PO qday for 14 days or until discharge (COVID-19) ($$) R

Baricitinib 2 mg NG qday for 14 days or until discharge (COVID-19) ($$) R

Baricitinib 2 mg G Tube qday for 14 days or until discharge (COVID-19)

($$) [R]

# Patients with eGFR 15-29 ml/min/1.73 m2:

Baricitinib 1 mg PO qday for 14 days or until discharge (COVID-19) ($$) R

Baricitinib 1 mg NG qday for 14 days or until discharge (COVID-19) ($$) R

Baricitinib 1 mg G Tube qday for 14 days or until discharge (COVID-19)

($$) [R]

# Patients with an eGFR < 15ml/min/1.73 m2 or those on dialysis:

Baricitinib is NOT recommended
